Now, in that case, you could of course add
the documentation of that package as extra
context. You could do that, but you could
also consider fine-tuning a specific model
that
automatically knows more about that package

code. And how do you do that? Well, you use

once you're ready with them, you can use
them as fine-tuning data. And that would be
one example for using synthetic data for
